Hackathon

Code meets the starting line.

The story

A visual identity for a technological race, bringing the language of coding into the energy of a marathon.

Client
Hexa Connection
Focus
Branding

Coding symbols form the starting point for the Hackathon logo, with a dash reimagined as the beginning of a running track.

Created for an event during the COVID pandemic, the visual language pairs red and blue with textured backgrounds, hands and microbe-inspired shapes to reflect the urgency of that moment.
